name: Kerb & Camber
short: Type your reg into a real number plate and the MOT date and next free slots come back.
long: The hero is a UK number plate set into the workshop photo: type the reg, press Check, and the headline turns into the answer, "MOT due in 247 days.", with the next three free half-hours under it. Tap one and the booking sheet is already filled in: MOT, the day, the time and the reg. Below it a pinned job card walks a real MOT from 08:30 to 09:40, then the price board as it hangs by the office door.
proves: Somebody who does not know when their MOT is due can find out and book it before they close the tab.
story: Half the calls a garage takes are somebody asking when their MOT is due. Answering it on the page turns that call into a booking.
